title: Frantik teamed up with O2K for the new single "100 ON THE DASH".
htmlContent:
Canadian-based rapper and songwriter Frantik shares a new single, "100 ON THE DASH," featuring O2K. "100 ON THE DASH" stays in Frantik's production style, blending trap and hip hop. The song follows Frantik's recent "Swim" and "Art Not Giving A" singles. 

The track will easily capture audiences, and the intense lyricism provided by Canadian rapper Frantik will resound openly with listeners and take them on a trip. Listeners will experience various feelings through musical bars as Frantik pours his heart out about making his way to the top.

Everything you need to know about Frantik: 

Frantik is a hip-hop and R&B based out of Halifax, NovaScotia. He is a high-energy performer and has performed independently across Canada for four years. He draws from cloud rap, emo rap, indie rock, and trap influences, using the soundscape to tell his stories and speak his mind. Drawing from themes of love, personal growth, heartbreak, and mental health Frantik hopes to inspire others to feel comfortable in their skin.
